claim: MEC-14 retains the AKR catalytic tetrad
finding: Asp132-Lys163 2.70 A and Lys163-Tyr137 2.90 A match 1US0 (2.66, 3.11 A); the fourth position is Gln204 at 5.08 A from Tyr137 OH versus 3.70 A for AKR1B1 His110
context: AlphaFold Q20127 vs PDB 1US0 chain A, 1QRQ chain A
confidence: high for the three-residue relay (pLDDT 90-98); the Gln204 rotamer is a model, not a crystal structure

claim: The fourth tetrad position is His206
finding: Superposition onto AF L-GalDH (228 CA, 1.01 A RMSD) places Gln204 at the His124 site (tip 0.93 A); His206 is 5.76 A away, pLDDT 70
confidence: high; method does not depend on the sequence alignment

finding: Nicotinamide pocket is open (25 residues within 4.0 A of transferred NADP+, 3 clashes <2.0 A), but the 2'-phosphate site Lys262/Ser263/Arg268 of AKR1B1 maps to Asp354/Ser355/Gln358, a charge reversal shared with NAD+-dependent L-GalDH and with Kvbeta2
context: NADP+ from 1US0, NADPH from 1QRQ, transferred by Kabsch superposition
confidence: medium-high; predicts NAD(H) over NADPH, untested by assay

claim: MEC-14 substrate pocket resembles a characterised AKR
finding: Only 2 of 11 structurally matched AKR1B1 pocket residues keep type; aromatic lining 8/15 to 3/11; the C-terminal specificity loop Cys298-Tyr309 has no counterpart
context: IDD594 (LDT) contacts in 1US0 chain A mapped onto AF Q20127
confidence: high for loss of the AKR1B1 pocket; silent on what MEC-14 does bind

claim: MEC-14 belongs to a specific AKR subfamily
finding: Closest characterised relative is Arabidopsis L-galactose dehydrogenase at 42.4% identity over PF00248; next best characterised protein is Drosophila Hyperkinetic at 31.5%; human Kvbeta2 27.1%; AKR1B1 23.2%
context: 41-member AKR panel, PF00248-trimmed global alignment, BLOSUM62 affine gap
confidence: high; an 11-point margin over the next best

claim: The non-canonical site is a fixed family feature, not degeneration
finding: In 19 nematode orthologs (54.5-96.0% identity) Asp132 and Tyr137 are 100% conserved, Lys163 84.2%, Gln204 94.7%; no ortholog restores His at 204
context: UniRef50 cluster of Q20127; Caenorhabditis, Pristionchus, Haemonchus, Steinernema, Mesorhabditis

finding: mec-14 is required for touch sensitivity in C. elegans; no biochemical activity reported
confidence: phenotype only; gives no information on catalysis

claim: AKR nomenclature requires a measured function
finding: AKR superfamily assignment and family numbering are tied to characterised activity; uncharacterised relatives are not assigned
InterPro/CDD assign MEC-14 to cd19163 (L-GalDH-like) rather than cd19141 (Kvbeta/AKR6A); PF00248 spans residues 97-373 of 453
